text_block_list.text:
I hear strange, possibly spiritual
invocations
coming from inside the
waiting room. I take a
peek inside to
find...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Glory beee! Glory beee! Glory be...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Whew. I got so excited, I might have gotten way more into that chant than usual!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm going to make use of all
of my
motivation, courage, and luck in
this race!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
